summary.summary_zh: PaddleOCR 团队发布了 PP-OCRv5_server_det 的 ONNX 格式模型，这是 PP-OCRv5_det 系列中面向高性能应用的最新一代文本检测模型。该模型支持手写、竖排、旋转、弯曲等多种文本场景的检测，覆盖简体中文、繁体中文、英文和日文，并能稳健处理复杂版面、不同文字尺寸和困难背景。作为最新一代检测模型，它适用于文档分析、车牌识别和场景文字检测等实际应用，并可通过 onnxruntime 引擎进行推理部署。

innovations.title: Server 级高性能文本检测模型
innovations.detail: PP-OCRv5_det 系列中的 server 版本，面向高性能应用场景设计

innovations.title: 多语言多场景检测能力
innovations.detail: 支持简体中文、繁体中文、英文、日文，覆盖手写、竖排、旋转、弯曲文本以及复杂版面、困难背景

innovations.title: ONNX 格式发布
innovations.detail: 提供 ONNX 导出模型，可通过 paddleocr CLI 或 Python API 以 onnxruntime 引擎推理

summary.progress_note: 文中称其为最新一代文本检测模型，但未提供与前代的直接对比数据

training.data_mix: Bottom-up data construction from massive raw internal image corpus: 10,000 fine-grained category classification, VLM caption enrichment (emphasizing in-image text), aesthetic scoring via ERNIE-Image-Aes, and hierarchical inter-/intra-category sampling; category distribution: Photography 49.28%, Illustration/Anime 23.16%, Graphic Design/Posters 11.14%, Mixed Web Imagery 10.44%, Film Photography 5.42%, Product/Collectible 0.56%
pretrain_innovations: Bottom-up data construction with 10,000 fine-grained visual categories for long-tail preservation
Hierarchical sampling weighted by category size and aesthetic scores
ERNIE-Image-Aes aesthetic model used as unified quality signal for data filtering
posttrain_innovations: Top-down data construction pipeline curating high-consistency data for priority domains (posters, game screenshots, portraits, anime, etc.)
Diversified SFT annotations covering various user input styles to improve instruction following
Improved DPO with few steps to align human aesthetic preferences and minimize reward hacking
MT-DMD strategy using multiple expert variants to jointly provide supervision for distillation
ERNIE-Image-Turbo requiring only 8 NFEs; lightweight Prompt Enhancer for structured prompt expansion
